Parents and troop leaders may accompany the girls on the trail ride for $30.00 per adult or leader. services.desc: At Phantom Ranch we teach ‘Rider Independence’ in our horsemanship lessons. This means students are taught all aspects of horsemanship. Students are taught how to catch, groom, daily care and basic groundwork and riding techniques. Alongside all instruction is constant guidance of how to communicate well with the horse. services.name: Programs
services.desc: We offer a variety of unique ways to enjoy camp programs at Phantom Ranch year-round. There’s always something to do here at camp! Sending your child to summer camp is more than just a week away-it’s a life-changing experience for your whole family. Even if you’ve never been to camp yourself, you’ll see the impact when your child comes home. At camp, we’ve seen siblings grow closer, high schoolers rebuild relationships with parents, and single moms feel renewed by the joy their kids share after camp.
